summary: A nine-track groovebox where each track runs its own drum machine, synth engine or MIDI out, with 16-step patterns. It also runs on the M-VAVE SMK-37.
features: Modelled 808, 909, SDS-V, CR-78 plus ROM-sample kits and user samples
Felucca's synth engines plus STRING and SUPERSAW, with presets
40 patterns of 16 steps with accents, slides and ratchets
Delay, reverb and chorus sends, kick ducking, master filter, 11 distortions
USB and TRS MIDI in, clock in and out, a fixed CC per parameter
Separate build with Bluetooth MIDI; screen mirroring over USB
